nodes.title: director15: script walk v6.6 on int/r6 2e9664b34 (integration 19), run by main, 16 lessons, 1,522 calls ~$1.035; reply-ready per-lesson p50 median 2640→2860 ms; counted by hand by 4 Claude judges (0-based rows, by mechanism): beats 265/266 (99.6%), verdicts 260/263 (the 3 misses all from the content-filter fallback), misgrades 0/0, false keys 0; contradictions 5 by main's consistent ruling (paging 4, data 1) vs director14 22, the lowest of round 7 (judges' raw count 7: the c4 judge also counted 2 bare miss verdicts naming the child's answer on the remediation's page, a shape the other three judges and director13/14 did not count, ~18 more instances); per topic c4 1, c5-t01 0 (from 10), c5-t02 2, c6 2; verdict-then-next-card turns paged correctly 132/134; picture turns 14/14 two pages. Listening 3 in all four topics; register 3–3.5; promises 2–3 (asides lost or parked in every topic); screen and speech 3.5–4.5. H3 counter missed 4 of 5 hand rows with ~20 false flags.

Script walk v6.7: asides that come back; every path through the parts. Brain: A3 root-cause why A2 did not fire live, with predicates replayed from the director15 rows (a taste question answered on the asking turn, 0 parked; every parked aside returned by its card's close or the wrap, 0 lost; an aside question ends her turn; a repeated aside acknowledged; an aside reply states nothing not in the child's words); P5 the content-filter fallback, B1′ and worked-step paths build parts, a fallback drops only model parts (every graded turn has a verdict part; every part on its own beat's board); P4′ a miss verdict naming the child's answer or a value is said on the answered card's page before the remediation's (counted as paging from director16); B1″ the live beat is the open card's beat or the running worked step, never a closed card, an untaught point or a remediation's board, and 'Ab Hindi mein' changes the words; V1′ the hook is authored only, a second miss always takes the scripted give-up (no model 'break'), no method reads; R4 register on the code side (the worked problem stated once, no 'Diya hai… Dhoondhna hai…' recital, varied close joints, check-ins 3–5 forms at most every third turn, mark→nishaan never touches 'question mark', no gender slips); K4 'aage chalo' after a closed card moves on, 'pata nahi, aap batao' gets the simpler, a first miss never a bare re-pose; H4 the counter checks each part's beat against the drawn page's beat, counts the P4′ shape, must flag director15's 5 hand rows plus the P4′ rows with ≤2 other false flags; speed: find the +220 ms. Studio: S9b root-cause c6 stuck 18 (no second view on a remediation's board). Learning: D10 the register rewrite of the four pilots' spoken fields (reversal clause 2 taken), the ask-board '?' lint, the c5-t02 s1 and c5-t01 key leaks, the validator's 'no later key' extended to then-cards and later distractors. Why: director15 contradictions 22→5 with false keys back to 0 and P4 paging 132/134 closes correctly; the remaining contradictions and all 3 missing verdicts are paths that bypass P4; listening, register and promises fail in every topic, led by lost or parked asides. Clause 1 not triggered at 4 by a consistent ruling (raw 6); clause 3 taken (counter missed 4/5). Reverse: director16 has more than 5 paging + second-view contradictions by hand with the P4′ shape counted → one code-drawn board per card, held, unconditionally; register still below 3.5 with D10 and R4 in place → code's frames move into the scripts, authored per topic by Learning; H4 misses more than 1 of the hand count → the 30-topic batch is screened only by hand judging.

## `dc-r7-script-walk-v6-7` (2026-11-09)

Asides that come back, and every path through the parts.

**Brain:**
- **A3:** root-cause the asides, with predicates replayed from the rows: 0 parked taste questions, 0 lost asides, an aside question ends her turn.
- **P5:** the fallback, Hindi/clarify and worked-step paths build parts; a fallback drops only model parts.
- **P4′:** a miss verdict that names a value goes on the answered card's page.
- **B1″:** the right live beat.
- **V1′:** no model hook, no model break, no method reads.
- **R4:** code-side register: no recital, varied joints and check-ins, "question mark" left intact.
- **K4:** help fixes.
- **H4:** the counter checks part beat against page beat.
- **Speed:** find the +220 ms.

**Studio:**
- **S9b:** root-cause the missing second view on a remediation's board.

**Learning:**
- **D10:** the register rewrite of the four pilots (clause 2 taken), plus a lint and two key leaks.

**Why:** contradictions fell from 22 to 5 and false keys are back to 0. What remains bypasses P4. Listening, register and promises fail everywhere, led by asides.

**Clauses:** clause 1 is not triggered at 4, under a consistent ruling; the raw count is 6, and the ruled shape counts from director16. Clause 3 is taken.

**Reverse if:**
- more than 5 paging plus second-view contradictions in director16, with the P4′ shape counted: the held board, unconditionally;
- register still below 3.5 after D10 and R4: the frames move into the scripts, per topic;
- the counter misses more than 1: the batch is screened by hand only.
